name: OneLogin Integration
project_description: OneLogin Integration turns a Drupal 11 site into a SAML 2.0 Service Provider (SP) using the official onelogin/php-saml toolkit, letting users authenticate against OneLogin or any SAML Identity Provider (IdP) instead of a local username and password. It exposes the standard SP endpoints (SP-initiated SSO, Assertion Consumer Service, Single Log Out and its service callback, and SP metadata), maps SAML attributes to a Drupal account (username, e-mail and roles), can auto-provision accounts on first login, synchronises Drupal roles from an IdP role attribute on every login, and can add a "Log in using SAML" link to the core login form or force all logins through the IdP.
